summary: Mission Produce filed an 8-K on May 29, 2026, announcing its completion of a two-step merger to acquire Calavo Growers. Under the Merger Agreement dated January 14, 2026, Mission's merger subs first merged with Calavo, then the surviving corporation merged into a second sub. The filing details shareholder consideration but does not state a specific price per share or premium. All required regulatory closings occurred on May 28, 2026. The board of each company recommended the transaction, though no financial advisors are named. A potential risk-arb angle is watching for any post-closing dissenting shareholder appraisal claims under California law.
